_comment: Minimal materiality/climate-risk persistence — added in Phase 11 so data-quality exceptions 8 and 9 (materiality topic missing financial score, climate risk missing residual score) are checked against real tables rather than being hypothetical. Full materiality/climate workflow (scoring UI, IFRS S1/S2 narrative generation) uses the pure logic already ported in functions/shared/pure/materiality-scoring.ts and climate-risk.ts; this schema is deliberately scoped to what those data-quality checks need.

columns.comment: Null triggers the 'materiality topic missing financial score' data-quality exception.

tables.comment: IFRS S2 climate-related H&S risks ONLY — heat stress, extreme-weather exposure, wildfire smoke, etc. Never ordinary incidents.

columns.comment: Null triggers the 'climate risk missing residual risk score' data-quality exception.
